name: Bauernhof Huberbauer & Ferienwohung Kaiserblick
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Huberbauer in Ebbs also goes by the name Ferienwohnung Kaiserblick. The establishment is categorized as an inn. The holiday apartments face the Kaisergebirge. The farm is used for agriculture and produces its own products. The accommodations are suitable for self-caterers and families. The location in Ebbs offers access to hiking and cycling trails. The establishment combines agriculture and accommodation under one roof. Here, guests experience everyday life on a farm in Tirol.
